name: 7/8 fusion groove
desc: Odd-meter 7/8 fusion kit groove: 909 kick anchoring 1 and the and-of-4, backbeat snare with ghost notes, hats running all seven eighths with rotating accents; peak doubles the hats and opens a ride cymbal lattice.

code.sparse: stack(s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.85).shape(.2), s("~ ~ hh ~ hh ~ hh").bank("RolandTR707").gain("<.4 .3 .45 .3 .38 .3 .42>").lpf(5000), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.5).lpf(3200)).mask("<1 1 1 [1 0]>").fast(${rate}).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.25), s("~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ sd").bank("RolandTR909").gain("0 0 .62 0 0 0 .55").lpf(3600), s("~ sd ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain("0 .16 0 .14 0 0 0").lpf(2400), s("hh hh hh hh hh hh hh").bank("RolandTR707").gain("<.5 .28 .42 .3 .48 .28 .38>").lpf(sine.range(4200,6400).slow(16)).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(12))).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply("1 1 1 1 1 1 2")).fast(${rate}).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd bd").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.3), s("~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ sd").bank("RolandTR909").gain("0 0 .66 0 0 0 .6").lpf(3800), s("sd ~ ~ sd ~ sd ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain("[.18 0 0 .16 0 .14 0]").lpf(2400), s("hh*14").bank("RolandTR707").gain("[.5 .22]*7").lpf(sine.range(5000,7500).slow(12)).pan(sine.range(.38,.62).slow(8)), s("rd ~ rd ~ rd ~ rd").gain("<.4 0 .34 0 .38 0 .3>").lpf(6000).pan(.62), s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ cr").gain(.22).lastOf(4, x=>x.gain(.3))).fast(${rate}).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
